Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original fine-art still image, landscape 3:2
Title for concept only (do not print it): The seam remembers / 缝隙记得

Create one exquisitely quiet, emotionally charged studio photograph of a small hand-sewn repair in a large worn indigo linen curtain, suspended in darkness. The entire image is cloth, shadow, and one seam; no room, no window frame, no objects. A small vertical tear, slightly right of center and below mid-height, has been loosely mended with four irregular, thin vermilion stitches. Late afternoon light behind the fabric escapes through the narrow imperfect tear, illuminating tiny loose flax fibers. The repair should feel like care, not injury. At first glance the viewer sees a warm sliver of light against deep blue; only upon a closer look do the delicate red hand stitches and imperfect woven threads become apparent.

Composition: wide horizontal image, 60% of frame quiet dark indigo negative space especially to the left and top, not featureless black. A single broad soft vertical fabric fold through the right third. The lit tear occupies only about one fifth of the image height, isolated, modest and intensely beautiful. No repeated decorative motifs. Asymmetrical, unforced framing, contemplative stillness, sophisticated museum photographic print. Camera nearly parallel to cloth, textile texture clearly resolved at the seam while falling softly into darkness away from it.

Materials and light: genuinely irregular natural linen weave, softened worn fibers, four physically credible stitches spanning the tear with tiny contact shadows and subtly different tensions. Restrained warm ivory transmitted light, not a neon glow; muted indigo-black cloth; a few deep vermilion thread accents. Very gentle film grain, rich subtle shadow gradation, no artificial HDR, no gloss. The upper end of the slit has one almost invisible loose fiber bending into the light, the second discovery. Optical realism, tactile and intimate, not polished 3D.

Avoid: text, typography, labels, watermarks, logos, people, hands, faces, insects, plants, landscapes, moons, stars, circles, rings, minerals, water, waves, machinery, collage, multiple panels, ornate embroidery, decorative patchwork, jagged wound-like opening, dramatic rays, sparks, bokeh balls, orange-blue blockbuster grading, digitally glowing edges. One image only.
